messages:
Sam H: Hey team — Acme reported that their month-end invoice total is ~14k higher than the dashboard. They sent the invoice PDF and a CSV export; looks like an extra planline for 'enterprise-pro' showed up that doesn't exist in the dashboard.
Priya B: Thanks Sam. Do we have the invoice line id or invoice_ts?
billing-bot: invoice_generated id=inv_2024_12_31_788, lines=4, total_usd=14200.00
Sam H: Invoice line snippet: 
```
line_id: L-9a2f
product: tokens
plan: enterprise-pro
units: 1,400,000
unit_price: $0.01
```

Sam H: Dashboard export (user-scoped) only shows 1,200,000 tokens under account namespace `acme-main`. invoice shows 1,400,000 under `acme-enterprise` namespace.
Ava C: Customer says they never had `acme-enterprise` as an active namespace this month. They did a plan migration on Dec 28 but reverted on Dec 29.
Jorge L: Possible hypothesis: backfill job that aggregates late events might tag rows with the new plan namespace when migration was in flight. Need to check metering pipeline for late rekeying.
Priya B: Can you repro via SQL? If we query raw metering events for acct=acme between 2024-12-28 and 2024-12-31, do we see namespace flips?
Jorge L: Running quick query: 
```
SELECT namespace, sum(tokens) FROM raw_metering
WHERE account_id='acct_876' AND ts >= '2024-12-28' AND ts < '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY 1;
```
Result: `acme-main: 1,200,000`, `acme-enterprise: 200,000`
Jorge L: Looks like 200k tokens exist under `acme-enterprise` in raw. Need to check if dashboard export filters out `acme-enterprise` because the active plan mapping reverted back to `acme-main` at cutoff.
Ava C: So invoice included both namespaces but dashboard only shows currently-mapped namespace. That would explain totals. Customer expects invoice to follow dashboard, so this is confusing.
Sam H: Is this the expected behavior? Invoice should bill for usage regardless of final mapping at export time, right?
Priya B: Our billing pipeline uses our canonical invoice namespace mapping at the time invoices are generated (invoice job includes all namespaces seen in raw events for the period). Dashboard uses the latest active namespace mapping when a user filters by 'current plan'. So mismatch can happen for migrations. We should confirm if migration revert changed the dashboard filter.
Jorge L: Quick check in migration logs: `plan_migrations` table shows migration from acme-main -> acme-enterprise at 2024-12-28T03:11Z, revert to acme-main at 2024-12-29T10:45Z. Late ingest job `embed-raw-backfill` processed events on 2024-12-30 and labeled them with namespace `acme-enterprise` (it used the namespace from event payloads which were produced during the crit window).
Sam H: So invoice is correct as per raw events; dashboard hides the `acme-enterprise` namespace because final account mapping is `acme-main`. Customer expects to see billed items in dashboard though.
Ava C: Suggested customer-facing wording: "We found usage recorded under a short-lived namespace during your plan migration. The invoice includes that usage because it was ingested under that namespace during the billing period; the dashboard view you were looking at shows usage aggregated to the current namespace mapping, which hides the transient namespace. We're updating the dashboard export to include historical namespaces for the bill period."
Priya B: Action items: (1) Billing to add a reconciliation column to the dashboard export that includes 'raw_namespace' and invoice_line_id. (2) Engineering to add a backfill that collapses transient namespaces for UI queries for month-end reconciliation. (3) Notify customer and offer credit if they dispute.
Jorge L: Quick patch: change dashboard query to union `raw_namespace` for reports where `report_date` within invoice window. I pushed a small change to `reporting-service` branch `include-raw-ns-eom` — will run staging export.
Sam H: Customer asked for repro steps so they can verify: can we provide the SQL and instructions?
Priya B: Repro steps for CS: 1) Run raw_metering query (we gave above) for their account and date range. 2) Compare `raw_namespace` totals vs `ui_namespace` totals. 3) Pull invoice CSV — verify `line_id L-9a2f` mapped to `acme-enterprise`.
Ava C: I'll message the customer with the explanation + repro steps + timeline. Offering a one-time credit for the delta if they prefer.
Sam H: Thanks. Please mark as P2 and add to the month-end reconciliation board.
Priya B: Tagging finance for potential credit approval: @Priya B -> @Finance (fuel).
billing-bot: ticket created -> TKT-45789 (billing_recon_acct_876).
Jorge L: Follow-up: I'll run the staging export by EOD and post CSV. If QA passes we'll roll the dashboard fix to prod next week.
Ava C: Noted — will keep customer updated. :thumbsup:
